195	def normalize_filters(address=None, method=None, start_time=None, end_time=None,
196	                      from_address=None, to_address=None, min_amount=None,
197	                      max_amount=None, min_block=None, max_block=None,
198	                      status=None):
199	    """校验并归一化筛选条件。
200	
201	    ``method`` / ``from_address`` / ``to_address`` 接受单个字符串或
202	    字符串迭代器，归一化为去重集合（frozenset）；不给或为空则为 None。
203	    ``min_amount`` / ``max_amount`` 接受非负十进制整数字符串，按数值
204	    比较、闭区间，不给为 None；非法值抛 InvalidAmountFilterError，
205	    最小值数值大于最大值抛 InvalidAmountRangeError。
206	    ``min_block`` / ``max_block`` 接受非负整数（不含布尔值），闭区间，
207	    不给为 None；非整数值、布尔值或负数抛 InvalidBlockFilterError，
208	    最小值大于最大值抛 InvalidBlockRangeError。
209	    ``status`` 不给为 None（不筛选）；只接受精确的 ``"success"`` 或
210	    ``"failure"``（大小写敏感），空或空白、其他文本或非字符串抛
211	    InvalidStatusFilterError。
212	    """
213	    if address is not None and (
214	        not isinstance(address, str) or address.strip() == ""
215	    ):
216	        raise InvalidFilterError(
217	            "address 筛选值不能为空或仅含空白", None
218	        )
219	    if status is not None and (
220	        not isinstance(status, str) or status not in _VALID_STATUS
221	    ):
222	        raise InvalidStatusFilterError(
223	            "status 筛选只能是 success 或 failure", None
224	        )
225	    from_set = _normalize_value_set("from_address", from_address)
226	    to_set = _normalize_value_set("to_address", to_address)
227	    method_set = _normalize_value_set("method", method)
228	    if address is not None and (from_set is not None or to_set is not None):
229	        raise InvalidFilterError(
230	            "address 不能与 from_address / to_address 同时使用", None
231	        )
232	    for name, value in (("start_time", start_time), ("end_time", end_time)):
233	        if value is not None and (
234	            not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0
235	        ):
236	            raise ValueError("%s 必须为非负整数" % name)
237	    if start_time is not None and end_time is not None and start_time > end_time:
238	        raise InvalidTimeRangeError(
239	            "时间窗倒置：start_time(%d) 大于 end_time(%d)"
240	            % (start_time, end_time),
241	            None,
242	        )
243	    min_bound = (
244	        _normalize_amount_bound("min_amount", min_amount)
245	        if min_amount is not None else None
246	    )
247	    max_bound = (
248	        _normalize_amount_bound("max_amount", max_amount)
249	        if max_amount is not None else None
250	    )
251	    if min_bound is not None and max_bound is not None and (
252	        int(min_bound) > int(max_bound)
253	    ):
254	        raise InvalidAmountRangeError(
255	            "金额区间倒置：min_amount(%s) 大于 max_amount(%s)"
256	            % (min_bound, max_bound),
257	            None,
258	        )
259	    min_block_bound = (
260	        _normalize_block_bound("min_block", min_block)
261	        if min_block is not None else None
262	    )
263	    max_block_bound = (
264	        _normalize_block_bound("max_block", max_block)
265	        if max_block is not None else None
266	    )
267	    if min_block_bound is not None and max_block_bound is not None and (
268	        min_block_bound > max_block_bound
269	    ):
270	        raise InvalidBlockRangeError(
271	            "区块高度区间倒置：min_block(%d) 大于 max_block(%d)"
272	            % (min_block_bound, max_block_bound),
273	            None,
274	        )
275	    return {
276	        "address": address,
277	        "from_address": from_set,
278	        "to_address": to_set,
279	        "method": method_set,
280	        "start_time": start_time,
281	        "end_time": end_time,
282	        "min_amount": min_bound,
283	        "max_amount": max_bound,
284	        "min_block": min_block_bound,
285	        "max_block": max_block_bound,
286	        "status": status,
287	    }

290	def _matches(record, filters):
291	    if filters["address"] is not None:
292	        addr = filters["address"]
293	        if record["from_address"] != addr and record["to_address"] != addr:
294	            return False
295	    if (
296	        filters["from_address"] is not None
297	        and record["from_address"] not in filters["from_address"]
298	    ):
299	        return False
300	    if (
301	        filters["to_address"] is not None
302	        and record["to_address"] not in filters["to_address"]
303	    ):
304	        return False
305	    if (
306	        filters["method"] is not None
307	        and record["method"] not in filters["method"]
308	    ):
309	        return False
310	    ts = record["timestamp"]
311	    if filters["start_time"] is not None and ts < filters["start_time"]:
312	        return False
313	    if filters["end_time"] is not None and ts > filters["end_time"]:
314	        return False
315	    amount = int(record["amount"])
316	    if filters["min_amount"] is not None and amount < int(filters["min_amount"]):
317	        return False
318	    if filters["max_amount"] is not None and amount > int(filters["max_amount"]):
319	        return False
320	    block_number = record["block_number"]
321	    if filters["min_block"] is not None and block_number < filters["min_block"]:
322	        return False
323	    if filters["max_block"] is not None and block_number > filters["max_block"]:
324	        return False
325	    status = filters.get("status")
326	    if status is not None:
327	        # 记录未携带 success（如回放标准化记录）时按成功处理
328	        record_success = record.get("success", True)
329	        if status == STATUS_SUCCESS and record_success is not True:
330	            return False
331	        if status == STATUS_FAILURE and record_success is not False:
332	            return False
333	    return True

341	def validate_time_bucket_aggregation_params(start_time, end_time, bucket,
342	                                            address=None, method=None):
343	    """时间分桶聚合的入参校验（不依赖数据，可在读取数据文件前执行）。
344	
345	    返回 ``(method_set, width)``：method_set 为去重后的 frozenset 或
346	    None，width 为桶宽（UTC 秒）。时间范围缺失/倒置抛
347	    InvalidAggregationRange，桶粒度非法抛 UnsupportedAggregationBucket，
348	    地址或方法不符公开语义抛 InvalidAggregationFilter。
349	    """
350	    # 1. 时间范围：必填、非负 UTC 秒整数、左闭右开且非空
351	    if (
352	        not isinstance(start_time, int)
353	        or isinstance(start_time, bool)
354	        or not isinstance(end_time, int)
355	        or isinstance(end_time, bool)
356	        or start_time < 0
357	        or end_time < 0
358	        or end_time <= start_time
359	    ):
360	        raise InvalidAggregationRange(
361	            "时间分桶聚合要求 start_time、end_time 为非负 UTC 秒整数，"
362	            "且 end_time 严格大于 start_time（左闭右开）",
363	            None,
364	        )
365	
366	    # 2. 桶粒度：只支持小时与 UTC 自然日
367	    if not isinstance(bucket, str):
368	        raise UnsupportedAggregationBucket(
369	            "时间分桶聚合的桶粒度必须是 hour 或 day，收到：%r" % (bucket,),
370	            None,
371	        )
372	    width = _AGGREGATION_GRANULARITY_SECONDS.get(bucket)
373	    if width is None:
374	        raise UnsupportedAggregationBucket(
375	            "时间分桶聚合的桶粒度必须是 hour 或 day，收到：%r" % (bucket,),
376	            None,
377	        )
378	
379	    # 3. 地址 / 方法：沿用现有公开筛选语义，错误归入聚合筛选错误
380	    if address is not None and (
381	        not isinstance(address, str) or address.strip() == ""
382	    ):
383	        raise InvalidAggregationFilter(
384	            "address 筛选值必须为非空字符串", None
385	        )
386	    try:
387	        method_set = _normalize_value_set("method", method)
388	    except (InvalidFilterError, TypeError) as exc:
389	        message = (
390	            exc.message if isinstance(exc, InvalidFilterError)
391	            else "method 筛选值必须为字符串或字符串集合"
392	        )
393	        raise InvalidAggregationFilter(message, None) from exc
394	
395	    return method_set, width

435	class TxIndexer:

437	
438	    def __init__(self, records):
439	        # 加载顺序保留；查询时统一排序，不修改入参列表语义
440	        self._records = list(records)

442	    def append_records(self, records):
443	        """追加已校验记录（增量导入用），保持追加顺序。
444	
445	        追加后查询与聚合立即可见新记录；既有记录的顺序与内容不变，
446	        已签发的分页游标语义不受影响。
447	        """
448	        self._records.extend(records)

450	    def replace_records(self, remove_hashes, records):
451	        """删除指定 tx_hash 的记录后追加新记录（链重组替换用）。
452	
453	        仅删除 ``remove_hashes`` 中的记录，其余记录（含更低高度前缀
454	        以及内容完全相同、被保留的旧记录）原样保留，再按给定顺序追加
455	        新记录。替换后查询与全部统计入口立即只观察替换后的数据，排序
456	        仍在查询时统一进行。
457	        """
458	        if remove_hashes:
459	            self._records = [
460	                r for r in self._records if r["tx_hash"] not in remove_hashes
461	            ]
462	        self._records.extend(records)
463	
464	    def _matched(self, filters):
465	        matched = [r for r in self._records if _matches(r, filters)]
466	        matched.sort(key=lambda r: (r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]))
467	        return matched

469	    @staticmethod
470	    def _validate_page_size(page_size):
471	        if (
472	            not isinstance(page_size, int)
473	            or isinstance(page_size, bool)
474	            or page_size < 1
475	            or page_size > MAX_PAGE_SIZE
476	        ):
477	            raise InvalidPageSizeError(
478	                "page_size 必须为 1 到 %d 之间的整数（默认 %d）"
479	                % (MAX_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE),
480	                None,
481	            )

483	    def query(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
484	        """分页查询。返回 {transactions, total, next_cursor}。"""
485	        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
486	
487	        matched = self._matched(filters)
488	        total = len(matched)
489	
490	        start = 0
491	        if cursor is not None:
492	            after_block, after_tx_hash = decode_cursor(cursor, filters)
493	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
494	            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
495	            keys = [(r["block_number"], r["tx_hash"]) for r in matched]
496	            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, (after_block, after_tx_hash))
497	            if start < total and keys[start] == (after_block, after_tx_hash):
498	                # marker 命中现存记录本身：从其后一条开始
499	                start += 1
500	
501	        end = start + page_size
502	        page = matched[start:end]
503	        if end < total:
504	            last = page[-1]
505	            next_cursor = encode_cursor(
506	                filters, last["block_number"], last["tx_hash"]
507	            )
508	        else:
509	            next_cursor = None
510	
511	        return {
512	            "transactions": [to_public(r) for r in page],
513	            "total": total,
514	            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
515	        }

569	                success_amount += value
570	            else:

582	    def method_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, cursor=None):
583	        """按 method 分组的分页统计。
584	
585	        返回 {groups, total_groups, next_cursor}；每组含 method、
586	        total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为十进制整数字符串，
587	        平均值向下取整）。顺序：total_amount 降序、total_count 降序、
588	        method 的 Unicode 码点升序。
589	        """
590	        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
591	
592	        totals = {}
593	        counts = {}
594	        for record in self._records:
595	            if not _matches(record, filters):
596	                continue
597	            method = record["method"]
598	            totals[method] = totals.get(method, 0) + int(record["amount"])
599	            counts[method] = counts.get(method, 0) + 1
600	
601	        # (-total, -count, method) 升序即 total/count 降序、method 升序，
602	        # 同时得到可直接 bisect 的单调递增键
603	        methods = sorted(
604	            totals, key=lambda m: (-totals[m], -counts[m], m)
605	        )
606	        total_groups = len(methods)
607	
608	        start = 0
609	        if cursor is not None:
610	            (
611	                after_total,
612	                after_count,
613	                after_method,
614	            ) = decode_method_stats_cursor(cursor, filters)
615	            keys = [(-totals[m], -counts[m], m) for m in methods]
616	            marker = (-after_total, -after_count, after_method)
617	            # keyset 续页：排序键严格大于 marker 的第一个位置。
618	            # marker 位于两键之间也安全（bisect 取下一键），不会跳过或重复。
619	            start = bisect.bisect_left(keys, marker)
620	            if start < total_groups and keys[start] == marker:
621	                # marker 命中现存分组本身：从其后一组开始
622	                start += 1
623	
624	        end = start + page_size
625	        page_methods = methods[start:end]
626	        groups = [
627	            {
628	                "method": method,
629	                "total_count": counts[method],
630	                "total_amount": str(totals[method]),
631	                "avg_amount": str(totals[method] // counts[method]),
632	            }
633	            for method in page_methods
634	        ]
635	        if end < total_groups:
636	            last = page_methods[-1]
637	            next_cursor = encode_method_stats_cursor(
638	                filters, totals[last], counts[last], last
639	            )
640	        else:
641	            next_cursor = None
642	
643	        return {
644	            "groups": groups,
645	            "total_groups": total_groups,
646	            "next_cursor": next_cursor,
647	        }

649	    def method_status_stats(self, filters, page_size=DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
650	                            cursor=None):
651	        """按 method 分组并拆分成功/失败计数与金额的分页统计。

653	        使用与 query 相同的筛选（含 status）。每个 method 分组返回
654	        method、total_count、total_amount、avg_amount（金额为无前导零
